title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Complete Edition
titleEn: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Complete Edition
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Complete Edition brings Geralt of Rivia’s enormous open-world RPG to Nintendo Switch. Players hunt monsters, investigate contracts, make difficult story choices, and search for Ciri across the Northern Kingdoms. The Complete Edition includes the base game and the major expansions Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine, plus the released DLC package.

nintendoNotes: This file is for the 2019 Nintendo Switch Complete Edition. A newly announced native Nintendo Switch 2 Remastered version is kept as a separate product file. The Complete Edition contains the base game and the two major expansions.

gameplayPillars.title: Open-world monster hunting
gameplayPillars.description: Geralt travels between large regions, tracks monsters, prepares oils and potions, and takes contracts.

gameplayPillars.title: Choice-driven quests
gameplayPillars.description: Main and side stories frequently react to dialogue choices and decisions with lasting consequences.

gameplayPillars.title: Real-time Witcher combat
gameplayPillars.description: Swordplay, dodges, Signs, bombs, crossbows, and alchemy combine into a flexible combat system.

gameplayPillars.title: Deep RPG progression
gameplayPillars.description: Skill trees, gear sets, crafting, mutagens, and character builds support different play styles.

gameplayPillars.title: Huge expansion content
gameplayPillars.description: Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine add substantial story regions, characters, bosses, and endgame content.

worldSummary: The Northern Kingdoms span war-torn villages, cities, islands, forests, swamps, mountains, and the colorful duchy of Toussaint, with dense side quests and environmental storytelling.

storyChapters.title: Search for Ciri
storyChapters.body: Geralt follows clues across the Continent while the Wild Hunt pursues his adopted daughter.

storyChapters.title: Navigate political conflict
storyChapters.body: The search intersects with rulers, mages, criminals, soldiers, and ordinary people caught in war.

storyChapters.title: Confront the Wild Hunt
storyChapters.body: The central story escalates toward the supernatural riders pursuing Ciri and threatening the people around Geralt.

storyChapters.title: Hearts of Stone
storyChapters.body: The first major expansion introduces Olgierd von Everec and the mysterious Gaunter O’Dimm.

storyChapters.title: Blood and Wine
storyChapters.body: The second major expansion sends Geralt to Toussaint for a large new mystery and a fitting late-game conclusion.

features: Base game plus Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine
Massive open-world RPG adapted for portable play
Meaningful quest choices with multiple outcomes
Cross-save support was added through later Switch updates
Dozens of hours of high-quality side quests and contracts

faq.q: Does the Switch Complete Edition include both major expansions?
faq.a: Yes. The Complete Edition includes Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine along with the base game and released DLC.

faq.q: Is this the new Switch 2 Remastered version?
faq.a: No. This file is for the original Nintendo Switch Complete Edition. The 2026 native Switch 2 Remastered release is separate.

faq.q: Can save data be moved to other platforms?
faq.a: Later updates added cross-save support with supported PC ecosystems.
No. The Witcher 3 is a single-player RPG.

faq.q: How compromised is the Switch version?
faq.a: It uses reduced resolution and visual settings relative to more powerful platforms, but preserves the complete gameplay and story package.

verdictPros: Complete package includes two excellent expansions
Portable version preserves an enormous RPG
Excellent value in terms of content length
verdictCons: Visual quality is reduced on original Switch
30 fps target can dip in demanding areas
Small text/UI may need adjustment in handheld play
Combat is less precise than the strongest dedicated action games
Large install size for Switch storage
